script.title: Why IndiGo Lost ₹1,879 Crore #shorts

segments.text: IndiGo just lost 1,879 crore rupees in three months.
Wait, your flight ticket costs 7,000 rupees and every single seat is packed!
So where did all the paisa go?
Airlines don’t make money on tickets; they burn it on fuel.
Aviation fuel eats nearly 40% of operational expenses, taxed heavily across India.
Add aircraft leases paid in rising US dollars and heavy airport fees, and profits vanish.
Now, IndiGo says ticket price hikes are inevitable.
Which explains why domestic airfares keep climbing, even though...

script.description: How does India's biggest airline lose ₹1,879 crore in a quarter when flights are completely full? We break down the brutal economics of aviation fuel, taxes, and ticket margins. #IndiGo #Aviation #BusinessNews
